notes: Multi Studio version 2.1.41: **Instant Transcription Cancellation**: Fixed the Cancel button in AI Scriber so clicking Stop/Cancel immediately stops the active spinner, clears progress messages, and resets processing clips back to pending without hanging or freezing., **3-Minute Safety Timeout**: Added a 3-minute request timeout guard on AI transcription calls to prevent network drops or API hangs from leaving files stuck in processing., **Seamless Segment Playback Boundaries**: Fixed segment audio playback alignment to stop cleanly at the exact segment end timestamp, eliminating the ~0.5s audio cutoff at the start and preventing audio from bleeding into adjacent segments.
